verdict.rationale: First-party docs say self-hosting runs the complete Flagsmith platform on your own infrastructure with full control over your data, and describe a Docker setup for an entire environment. A self-hosted Edge Proxy also keeps flag evaluation close to your servers, and the public GitHub repo points to a source distribution. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open-source license and of which features ship in the open-source edition versus paid tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a production self-hosted deployment.
